notes: The supplied Road 1 configuration retains the original smooth southern return, northern inner hairpin and oval-front-straight return. The operator distinguishes its 1.6-mile course from the later 2.0-mile extension. This draft follows the original paved route visible in the pinned public-domain 2019 NAIP image; independent historical public-node alignment aided branch identification. The newer southern extension, kart course, dragway and pit road are excluded. Coordinates come from independent public georeferencing, without fitting the supplied diagram or scalar. Historical direction and fine corner alignment remain draft. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 2602.8 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 73 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
